title: What is the new ratio after adding a bucket of yellow?
description: A bucket of orange paint has red and yellow in the ratio three to five, and another bucket of yellow is added. Taking both buckets to hold the same amount, only the yellow grows, as only the cement grew in the mixture example in the book.
teaching_notes: One idea: split one bucket into equal groups, then add the groups of the colour that was added and leave the other colour alone. Watch for students who add the whole bucket to both colours.

video_script.why: The child finds a new ratio after one part of a mixture is increased, keeping the other part fixed.
video_script.substitution: Split one bucket into groups, add the groups of the colour that was added, keep the other colour and write the new ratio.
video_script.anchor: a bucket of orange paint next to a second bucket of yellow paint
video_script.payoff_line: red to yellow is now three to thirteen
maths_rules: assume both buckets hold the same amount
one bucket: 3 + 5 = 8 groups; red 3 groups, yellow 5 groups
a full bucket of yellow adds 8 groups of yellow: 5 + 8 = 13; red stays 3
video_script.design: One idea: groups per bucket, then only the added colour grows. The two buckets stay in the anchor band and the working goes on the board.

narration: <bookmark mark='groups'/>Step one, add the terms three and five, so one bucket has eight equal groups.
<bookmark mark='parts'/>Three groups are red and five groups are yellow.

beats.on_screen: a bucket of yellow adds 8 groups of yellow: yellow = 5 + 8 = 13 groups; red stays 3 groups
narration: <bookmark mark='add'/>Step two, a full bucket of yellow adds eight more groups of yellow.
<bookmark mark='yellow'/>The yellow is five plus eight, which is thirteen groups.
<bookmark mark='red'/>The red does not change, so it stays three groups.

beats.on_screen: put the answer back: red 3 + yellow 13 = 16 groups; two buckets = 2 × 8 = 16 groups

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step three, put the answer back in the question.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Three plus thirteen is sixteen groups in all.
<bookmark mark='buckets'/>Two buckets of eight groups is also sixteen groups, so the groups match.

beats.on_screen: Answer: red : yellow = 3 : 13 (taking both buckets to hold the same amount)
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Red to yellow is now three to thirteen.
